tools.name: request_payment
tools.description: Creates a payment request for an approved invoice. Dry run by default. Requires a valid approval ID and idempotency key. Returns status 'dry_run', 'created', or 'replayed'.

invoice_number.description: The invoice number to be paid

amount.description: Payment amount. Must match the invoice total

approval_id.description: Human approval reference in APR-XXXXXX format

idempotency_key.description: Unique request key used to prevent duplicate payment requests

dry_run.description: Validate only without creating a payment request

tools.name: record_invoice_decision
tools.description: Records the final processing outcome of an invoice in the ERP system. If the invoice has already been recorded for the vendor, returns the existing status without making changes.

total_amount.description: Invoice total amount. Must be greater than zero

po_number.description: Associated purchase order number, if applicable

reason.description: Short explanation for the decision (maximum 200 characters)
